import io
p = "scripts/scan-secrets"
s = io.open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
old = """  # A dotted lowercase config key, e.g. GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = credential.interactive
  printf '%s\\n' "$value" | grep -qE '^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(\\.[a-z0-9]+)+$' && continue
"""
new = """  # A dotted lowercase config key, e.g. GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0 = credential.interactive
  printf '%s\\n' "$value" | grep -qE '^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(\\.[a-z0-9]+)+$' && continue
  # An EMAIL ADDRESS is never a credential, and the `*AUTH*` name pattern above
  # matches `AUTHOR`: GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL / GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL are selected by
  # name and hold a public address. The owner's is already committed in nine
  # tracked files INCLUDING public/introspect/source-snapshot.json, which is
  # regenerated on nearly every change — so where these are set this refused
  # almost every commit, and the way round it is --no-verify, which turns the
  # gate off entirely. A false positive that teaches people to bypass the
  # scanner is worse than no scanner.
  printf '%s\\n' "$value" | grep -qE '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+\\.[^@[:space:]]+$' && continue
"""
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
io.open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("patched scan-secrets")

BAK='/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Deepresearch-se/cfdf7483-1001-575c-94e7-e4d53ed9010a/scratchpad/re.py.bak'
P='pygram/lib/re.py'
perts = [

  ('backslash template refusal', 'if not isinstance(repl, str) or "\\\\" in repl:', 'if not isinstance(repl, str):'),

  ('the whole gate', 'def _can_use_native_sub(p, repl):', 'def _can_use_native_sub(p, repl):\n    return True'),
]

    assert s.count(old) == 1, (name, s.count(old))
    io.open(P, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s.replace(old, new, 1))
    r = subprocess.run(['node','--test','tests/pygram/shims.test.mjs'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    line = [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('# fail')]
    print(f'{name:32s} -> {line[0] if line else "?"}')
shutil.copy(BAK, P)
print('restored:', subprocess.run(['git','diff','--stat',P],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip() or 'clean')
